scenes.line1: How do you keep npm installs safe?
scenes.say: How do you make sure your Node projects are secure and your dependencies don't break things?

scenes.label: npm
scenes.say: npm is your main tool for adding and managing dependencies in Node projects.
The lock file freezes exact versions, semver keeps upgrades predictable, and audit checks for security issues.

scenes.title: Audit Your Dependencies
scenes.say: Run the audit command to scan for vulnerable packages. It's a quick way to catch risks before they hit production.

scenes.question: Should you ignore package-lock.json?
scenes.right: No, always commit it. It locks dependencies so everyone gets the same versions.
scenes.say: Don't skip the lock file. Leaving it out can cause version drift and unexpected bugs.
